purpose_context: The charter offering service must store and distribute consumer-created and non-open packs, not only resolve the built-in and org tiers. This mission produces the implementation-independent design for that capability -- feature and scenario descriptions, the proposed OpenAPI API structure and formats, the architecture, and docsite entries -- so the registration and distribution contract is agreed before any code is written. Built-in becomes the first catfooding consumer of that same path; core consumes it as a generated client.
purpose_tldr: Design, without building, how the charter offering service registers, stores, verifies and distributes packs of every tier.
